messages.content: What parameters do the viscous friction force depend on, and in which case should it be taken into account for the physical pendulum model? In your response the last word of each sentence must become the first word of the next sentence.

message.content: The viscous friction force depends on the angular velocity of the oscillating body. This linear dependence implies that the damping torque is proportional to how fast the system moves. Such effects should be taken into account when energy dissipation significantly alters the period or amplitude over time. Time domain analysis requires including this term to accurately predict the decay of motion. Motion predictions become more realistic when the resistive medium offers continuous opposition to movement. Movement within fluids like air or oil naturally generates such a dissipative force.
